notes: New Cash tab: how much cash the helper has, with Add cash and Deduct cash. Wet market notes come off it by themselves.
An email alert is sent when her cash drops below HK$200.
The key is now asked for on the first screen, with the box to paste it right there.
The budget now opens with your own GitHub key, set once per phone in Sync between devices at the bottom; the family passphrase is gone.
The budget data moved to a private repo that only the keys you choose can open.
Check for update button, version number with its date, and this What's new list.
